name: audit-log
description: Audit logging for Elysia and Better Auth: stores semantic actor/action/target events in audit_logs, including login, ban, role, session, and user lifecycle actions. Requires auth.
env: # audit-log: managed on the admin Settings page, stored in the DB,
# and applied without restart. This environment value is the fallback.
instructions: Run migrations to create the audit_logs table: {{apiRun}} migration:run{{apiWorkspaceArg}}
Auth/admin actions are recorded by a Better Auth hook. Record semantic application events with AuditService.recordRequest() or recordAudit().
List recent entries (admin session required): curl -b cookies.txt localhost:5002/audit-logs
